evidence.excerpt: We introduce AdShot, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on shot selection for ad clipping.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at general video understanding, their ability to perform specialized editorial tasks remains unexplored.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate 13 state-of-the-art video-only MLLMs and 2 audio-visual MLLMs (7B-72B parameters) on shot selection accuracy (Precision, Recall, F1), duration constraints (15s), and content preservation, including an audio ablation.
